unknown: UNKNOWN with owner and condition in index; not an inferred failure or approval
time: UTC checked_at preserves historical acceptance time; capture time separately recorded
pointer: project-relative Markdown links to original receipts/native records or byte captures with original absolute path provenance
authority: Task cards own state; index owns dated facts only; no final self-referential SHA
verification: tests validate schema/pointers, not truth; independent reviewer owns approval
